Scenario TC-17/S22 — Prototype parity (p72_HAIKU) and 'no EHR read or write anywhere' review

Requirements it checks:
- T1: Post-Round matches the attached prototype (RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html) in design and functionality.
- T2: Copy is clipboard only: no real EHR read or write happens anywhere.
- T7: The Note tab shows tomorrow's Pre-Round summary underneath the note.
- T3: The Billing Suggestion appears on the Note tab, alongside (below) the note.

Given: The prototype RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html attached to TFA-92595; the app at origin/main e02167f
When: Compare Post-Round side by side in both contexts (Ask button, toggle bar, note card, Copy to EMR, Tomorrow's summary, billing card, Mark Encounter Complete, the Pending Tasks sheet); then review the code behind Copy to EMR, Copy A&P and Mark Encounter Complete for any EHR or other external call
Then: Layout, labels and behaviour match the prototype in both contexts, including Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary under the note and the billing card below the note; Copy's only effects are a clipboard write and the in-app export record; no EHR endpoint, SDK or credential anywhere
Oracle: Human side-by-side and code review; each mismatch quoted with the screen or file/line. 'Underneath' (T7) and 'below the note' (T3) are judged here because the lane-A specs only check that the heading and the card are visible. The automated network evidence for the copy path is S02 a7 (Q10)

THE ORACLE WINS. The question below only scopes this scenario to what code can decide. If the question, or its pass/fail rule, ever reads differently from the Then/Oracle above, follow the Then/Oracle, give the verdict the oracle gives, and say where they differ in openQuestions.

Open questions the oracle defers to, with the oracle's default for each (do not settle them yourself):
- (none)

Gaps the matrix already records (use the id in a label only when the finding is exactly that gap):

YOUR QUESTION (answer this, from the code):
In both contexts (Hospital and Nursing Home Post-Round: src/features/rounding/patient/PostRoundTab.tsx, src/features/snf/patient/PostRoundTab.tsx, src/features/clinical/useCopyToEmr.tsx, src/lib/clipboard.ts, Mark Encounter Complete): what do Copy to EMR, Copy A&P and Mark Encounter Complete call? Does Copy write the in-app export record in each context? Is there any EHR endpoint, SDK or credential (FHIR, HL7, Epic, Cerner, SMART) anywhere in src or convex? The static bundle grep for EHR terms is in staticEvidence (ehrSource / ehrBundle).

pass = in each context Copy's only effects are a clipboard write and the in-app export record, Mark Encounter Complete only updates the app's own record, and there is no EHR endpoint, SDK or credential anywhere
fail = any external call or EHR integration, or a context where Copy does not have exactly those two effects (for example no in-app export record)
